caption_L1: Here a is a bar chart called Chelsea FC revenue by stream from 2008/09 to 2018/19 (in million euros). Season is shown on the y-axis. Commercial is measured on a linear scale from 0 to 200 on the x-axis.
caption_L2L3: Though revenue does not increase with every season, overall the commercial revenue stream increases with time. Revenue was below 100 million euros for the 2008/9 through 2012/13 seasons, above 100 million euros for the 2013/14 through 2017/18 seasons, and above 200 million euros for the 2018/19 season.
